scope_notes: Speed product is serial; native batch 2/4/8 is extension qualification.
5070-slot batch8 exhausts free VRAM; expert-r2 slows severely. Functional PASS is not capacity acceptance.
4096-slot expert-r2 batch8 leaves only about 0.39 GiB; 3584 slots measured about 1.13 GiB.
Initial main batch2 unknown-canary token equality failure retained; known-answer equality remains strict.
Canary is one artificial association; replay is also training material, not independent generalization.
FP8 observations cover nine synthetic/technical prompts, not real domain data.
No load-time weight SHA verification or hash cache; evidence inventories identify test outputs only.
